description: Implementation of the 'Diviyata Saviyak' Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - According to a Budget proposal 2025, the Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-08-18, granted approval for the implementation of the 'Programme to Provide Financial Assistance to Secure Housing Facilities to low-income couples reintegrated subsequent to institutional care'. Further strengthening the aforesaid programme, Rs.2,000 million has been allocated through the Budget proposals 2026 to provide a financial assistance of Rs.2 million per beneficiary, to individuals who, at any stage of their lives, have resided in child development centres and have been reintegrated into the society and to the families of vulnerable children, for the purpose of purchasing a land and constructing a house, constructing a house on a land owned by them, purchasing a house or renovating an existing house. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to provide the said financial assistance to the following beneficiary groups, based on the criteria formulated and the relevant procedure for providing financial assistance, was approved by the Cabinet:Individuals below 45 years of age who have left institutional care upon reaching the age of 18 years or earlier and do not have a stable and safe home for living.Families with children who are in vulnerable and at-risk situations as they do not have a safe home to live in due to the lack of a proper family background or a stable livelihood or because their current residence is not sufficiently safe for living.Children aged between 16 and 18 years who are in institutional care, as well as young men and women over the age of 18 years who continue to remain in Child Development Centers due to their inability to reintegrate into the society.
